label: D2 rare a2->S1 transition, mid-to-late episode (trials ~45-85)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when the reached state is S1 (99.9%); 97% of mass is on rare a2->S1 transitions (in_action=2, in_state=1), all observed at D2. Strongly gated by position in the episode: essentially silent before trial ~40 and after ~90, peaking at trials 50-80 - the agent can only infer this from an internal clock, so this condition is unusual. D2 & S1 & a2 alone gives recall 0.99 but precision 0.21; adding the episode-time window gives F1 0.64 on dev. Adding good==S2 or value<7.54 helps precision a little (F1 ~0.67) at a cost in recall. The largest activations (top of the range) are instead common a1->S1 trials made against a long a2 / S2-good history, a minor second mode (~2.5% of mass). Does not fire at D1 or GO, on S2, or on rewarded-input steps. Overall magnitude is tiny (max 0.002 above threshold).
